My work

From modeling behavior to shipping AI products

During my PhD, I worked on statistical modeling of searching, navigation, and cooperative behavior. During my postdoctoral research at Harvard, I built data and ML pipelines that automated extraction and analysis of behavioral data from videos at large scale. At LabXchange, an online education platform, I took data and AI pipelines into production. Now I build data and AI solutions across the full lifecycle, from problem-framing to deploying the system.

Education Technology

Interest-driven, interdisciplinary learning for real-world problem-solving

I am a proponent of learning through solving problems and answering questions that learners are interested in. This approach connects knowledge and skills across disciplines, sustains engagement and develops transferable skills, judgment, and agency to tackle unfamiliar problems. This adaptability to novel contexts is especially crucial in this rapidly changing world.

While technology has expanded access to educational content, learning experiences too often remain fragmented into disconnected subjects, with limited opportunities to apply the learning to the interest of the learners. AI grounded in carefully curated educational resources offers an opportunity to organize learning around individual interests and practical problem-solving, connecting foundational knowledge with inquiry and critical thinking. Combining my expertise in behavioral science, pedagogy, data, and AI/ML, I build tools across the education ecosystem - for learners, educators, and policymakers.

Teaching & Training

Learning through solving "your" problems and finding answers to "your" questions

I bring my learning philosophy to my teaching in Computational Behavioral Sciences, a course I developed and lead at Harvard University. In this course, students start from their own question about behavior, and learn the research methods, computational thinking, data science and applied AI/ML to answer it, building domain knowledge along the way. All the course matrials including codes are freely available on GitHub.

With information and generative AI at everyone’s fingertips, educators can no longer serve just as sources of information. They must teach problem-solving: constructing logic, collaborating, and finding, evaluating and assimilating information. I co-designed and delivered training for about 8,000 educators in India through LabXchange, and I regularly lead workshops on the changing role of educators in the age of AI. I plan to take this hands-on approach to collaborative learning, with teams mixed across countries rather than competing as national blocks.

Research

Understanding behavior across species and scales

Behavior is where biology, experience, and environment meet. I studied how individuals and collectives forage, navigate, remember, learn, make decisions, and cooperate, across wasps, ants, honey bees, and robots.

My approach is quantitative. I pair field and laboratory experiments with computer vision, then analyze the results using statistical modeling, causal inference, and machine learning, including deep learning. I developed Ethoscope, a Python pipeline for automated, large-scale extraction of behavior from video, freely available on GitHub for academic use.

At Harvard, I led research teams, line-managing and mentoring 40+ students and project staff, from hiring and performance reviews to tracking work against deadlines and budgets.

Future research interests

  • Large-scale behavioral science of individual, collective, and cooperative behavior in humans and other social animals
  • Cognition and learning in the context of education
  • Behavior in personal and public health

AI-native Startups

Trustworthy AI products, built end to end

AI products that handle personal data, like a career history or a live camera feed, have to earn trust by design, not by promise. I am building two, with co-engineers, both in alpha testing with invited users.

Founder · 2025–present

CViable

A multi-agent résumé, cover-letter, and mock interview studio, grounded in the user’s career record and tailored to individual jobs. An independent agent verifies every factual claim against its source before export. Users can inspect and edit every prompt steering the system.

  • Multi-agent systems
  • Hybrid RAG
  • LLM evaluation
  • Python
  • Django
  • AWS

Yogi’s Bliss

A vision-enabled, voice-first conversational AI yoga guide. Real-time pose estimation runs entirely in the browser, so user’s videos never leave their device. An on-device voice loop lets people practice without watching the screen. Safety rules are enforced in code rather than left to the language model.

  • Computer vision
  • On-device ML
  • Voice AI
  • Privacy engineering
  • WebGPU
  • Progressive web apps

About

My vision

I dream of a just world where all life is treated with dignity and growth works with nature instead of against it. I believe making high-quality, relevant education available to everyone is the most sustainable way to get there.

Learning outcomes are falling for much of the world. Too often, what students are taught doesn’t match what they want to learn, or what they will need. Education should spark curiosity, cross subject boundaries and prepare people for real problems, backed by what research tells us about how people learn.

Technology and AI can replace repetitive tasks, not humans, and augment the work people are passionate about. AI brings a new opportunity for a more equitable world, but seizing it would take a new kind of education, for everyone.
